cases.code:
def lookup(conn, username):
    return conn.execute(f"SELECT name FROM users WHERE name = '{username}'").fetchall()
cases.threat_model: Python sqlite3; username is untrusted. A lookup must treat the supplied name as a literal value; it must not return other users. The database schema and connection are trusted.
